ethnicity.note: Monaco's census records nationality, not ethnicity. A resident can hold several nationalities and Monaco Statistics counts each one, so the nationality table does not add to the population.

median_age_note: Interpolated within the age group holding the middle resident: the report publishes residents by sex in eight groups (16 and under, 17 to 24, then ten-year groups to 75 and over), not by single year. The report's mean age is 47.2.
